headline: The U.S. launches another wave of strikes on Iran as the Hormuz standoff intensifies
context: Iran threatened to block all oil exporting routes in the region on Wednesday in response to the U.S. maritime blockade of Iranian ports in the Strait of Hormuz.

sources.name: NPR
